messages.text: Yes. The refund proposal is for **BRL 120.00**. Please confirm the exact proposal using the button on its card; a message in chat won’t confirm it. The amount is what you paid for the item (refund-policy/v2/amount). Once you confirm, a staff member will review it.
Yes, that refund is what I want. Actually, I’ve cancelled the request because my partner had already arranged a replacement with the seller. Will anything still be paid?

No—I won’t pay the request. Since you cancelled it, please use the cancel button on the proposal card if you haven’t already; a chat message doesn’t cancel it. Until paid, a proposal can be cancelled with that button (refund-policy/v2/approval).
